top_needs.title: Practice efficiency gains and ROI with DM-monitored braces and aligners versus standard recall
top_needs.brands_and_products: Damon, ormco, KLOwen, Lightforce, Spark, Angel, suresmile, clearcorrect, Invisalign, self-ligating braces, twin brackets, damon ultima brackets, SmartSTL
top_needs.metrics_sought: chair time reduction, appointment frequency, ROI, profitability, time saving, visit reduction, rentability, ongoing monitoring costs vs benefits, efficiency in bracket systems, adaptive aligner change, average visit reduction, practice optimisation, emergencies decrease
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors question whether DM actually saves time or money, reduces appointments, or increases profitability, especially for braces. Some are skeptical that workflow changes will translate to real efficiency or financial gains in their specific practice setup.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: academic publication, case study, white paper, No format preference specified — reps asked for any available evidence
sample_queries: How can I make DM work in a practice with 8 chairs and 15 assistants in a way that they really get the real benefits and make it work financially as well in The Netherlands?
How much chair time reduction achieved
Show how can doctors increases the profitability if their practices using DM
Are Damon brackets more efficient than other brands?
Could you provide any data demonstrating improved patient compliance with DM or its impact on patient outcomes
top_needs.gap_assessment: Direct comparative studies quantifying ROI and efficiency for different appliances and practice types are limited. More real-world, multi-site data on cost savings and workflow impact would be valuable.

top_needs.title: AI diagnostic accuracy and reliability of DM versus human clinicians and other digital tools
top_needs.metrics_sought: AI accuracy, specificity and sensitivity, FDA class I, occlusal assessment, accuracy of AI detecting malocclusions, accuracy of AI versus orthodontist, accuracy of smartphone-based monitoring, accuracy of SmartSTL AI, accuracy of scanning, alignment unseat tracking
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors are skeptical about whether DM’s AI can reliably detect clinical issues, match or exceed human diagnostic accuracy, or be trusted for remote monitoring. Some express fear or distrust of AI replacing clinical judgment.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: academic publication, peer-reviewed, white paper, No format preference specified — reps asked for any available evidence
sample_queries: Information on the accuracy of DM, a patient has questioned the ability of the AI to detect clinical observations
Specificity and sensitivity results for FDA application

Occlusal Assessment: A quantitative study validating the AI’s accuracy in detecting malocclusions (midline deviation, overbite, overjet, and canine relationship) found that the mean bias across all parameters was less than 0.5 mm, confirming its reliability as a remote diagnosis and triage tool.
I have a doctor who doesn't trust the accuracy of the AI. I'd like to receive information regarding the accuracy.
How accurate is DentalMonitorings AI and will it save me money
top_needs.gap_assessment: Head-to-head studies comparing DM AI to orthodontists and other AI tools are rare. More peer-reviewed, quantitative validation studies are needed, especially for new features and regulatory submissions.
